Introduction

TC Flights Germany is known for operating one of the most successful flight search portals in Germany—fluege.de. We are part of Tongcheng Travel, an internationally active company in online travel distribution. Our vision is to be Germany’s top choice for comparing and booking flights.

We offer our customers a user-friendly and personalized booking experience. We achieve this together with all our employees, who proactively contribute their individual strengths and ideas in a flexible and modern work environment. We place great value on a positive and motivating atmosphere where everyone enjoys coming to work. We take the initiative, take responsibility, respect one another, drive change, are eager to learn, and develop solutions as a team.

Do you want to help shape the future of data-driven products at fluege.de? Are you comfortable working at the intersection of business, technology and data, and interested in not only developing AI solutions but also driving their strategic direction?

As a Product Owner Data & AI (m/f/d), you combine product ownership with expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science and Generative AI. Together with our business teams, you identify and prioritize high-value use cases and develop innovative solutions with measurable business impact. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of modern data and AI products and act as a key link between business, analytics and technology.

Does this sound interesting to you? Then join our team and help shape the future of data-driven products at fluege.de. This position is a temporary parental leave cover for approximately 15 months.

Your tasks

  • Own the roadmap for our Data, Analytics and AI products and prioritize initiatives based on business value and strategic relevance
  • Identify data-driven opportunities together with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into AI and Machine Learning solutions
  • Analyze complex datasets, develop predictive models and derive actionable recommendations
  • Design, build and evaluate Machine Learning models and modern AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and agent-based workflows
  • Manage the full product lifecycle, from problem definition and development to validation and production deployment
  • Ensure the operation, monitoring and continuous improvement of AI systems in modern cloud environments
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and other stakeholders while communicating progress, risks and results transparently

Your profile

  • Several years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI Engineering or Advanced Analytics
  • Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a similar role with responsibility for products, projects or complex initiatives
  • Strong knowledge of Python, SQL and modern Data Science and Machine Learning frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and operating AI and ML solutions in production environments
  • Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD, monitoring and the continuous improvement of production systems
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to connect technical and business requirements
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills

What we offer

  • Onboarding: professional orientation, buddy program, welcome week
  • Agile work environment: active participation in shaping our products and strategy
  • Work-life balance: 30 days of paid vacation, remote work in Germany and worldwide with Workflex, sabbatical, work-from-home option
  • Professional Development: Individual development plans, coaching, online/offline training and workshops, continuous feedback
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Certified climate partner since 2023
  • Food & Beverages: Meal allowance, free drinks and food
  • Recognition: Up to 34 vacation days depending on length of service, anniversary bonus, employee referral bonus
  • Events: Regular team, company, and office events

  • Diversity: Conscious focus on international teams and collaboration

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, B2B Trade Platform
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About this role

We're hiring a Director Product Management to own a core product area end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and ship it yourself, reporting directly to the founder.

 

What you will own

  • A P&L-relevant product area (logistics automation, pricing, or embedded finance) from discovery to shipped outcomes

  • Concrete targets, not vibes: we run on automation and retention metrics, and your area will have a number attached

  • Discovery with real users: traders, logistics operators, and buyers, weekly and in person

  • Prioritization and delivery with your engineering squad, including the calls on what not to build

  • Post-launch iteration driven by usage data and margin impact, not opinion

What you bring

  • 5+ years in product management with at least 2 at a B2B scale-up, owning a product area through significant growth

  • Shipped products in an operations-heavy domain: logistics, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech, or similar

  • Fluency with data: you pull your own numbers, define your own metrics, and change course when they tell you to

  • A track record of fast MVP cycles: built, measured, iterated or killed, and you can walk us through the decisions

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features to production is a strong plus

  • Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement

    What this role is not

  • Not a people-management role on day one. You'll lead through the product, with a path to building a team as the org scales.

  • Not a strategy-deck job. If your best work lives in slides rather than shipped product, this isn't the fit.

Who you are

  • You are slef-motivated, iterating fast, and eager for product success

  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership of a problem and makes sure it’s solved

  • You are comfortable with giving and receiving feedback for continuous improvement

  • A lifelong learner, someone who can dive into a domain quickly and become an expert

  • Data-informed, business-oriented and relentless in execution

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Senior Product Owner – Xsolla Money Account
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU
 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to help define, build, and scale the Xsolla Money Account. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex problem spaces, enjoys working hands-on with engineering and partners, and is motivated by turning ambiguity into shipped, high-quality products.

The Xsolla Money Account is a strategic initiative to build embedded financial services for gamers, creators, and developers. The product spans wallet capabilities, card issuing, payouts, and future financial tools that remove friction from how value moves across the gaming ecosystem. Sitting at the intersection of fintech and gaming, the Money Account enables new business models, creator monetization, and deeper player engagement.

You will own critical parts of the Money Account roadmap and execution, working closely with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable financial products. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, the ability to navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities, and consistent follow-through from concept through launch and iteration. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys staying close to execution and takes pride in seeing complex work through to completion.

This is a high-impact product area operating in a dynamic, evolving environment with meaningful technical, regulatory, and partner complexity. The opportunity is to shape foundational financial infrastructure that will scale globally and directly influence how money flows through the gaming economy.

 
ABOUT US
 
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
 
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Contribute to the Money Account product strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.

  • Identify opportunities to expand wallet, issuing, payouts, and related financial capabilities for gamers and creators.

  • Balance user experience, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and partner constraints when shaping solutions.

    • Product Definition & Delivery

  • Translate product strategy into clear, high-quality PRDs that provide context, rationale, and actionable requirements.

  • Partner closely with UX/UI designers to craft intuitive, trustworthy end-to-end user experiences.

  • Work with engineering teams using Jira and Confluence to manage scope, priorities, and delivery.

  • Drive features from ideation through build, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, compliance, legal, finance, marketing, and customer support teams.

  • Communicate goals, tradeoffs, and timelines clearly to maintain alignment across stakeholders.

  • Support internal enablement by helping teams understand new features, user flows, and operational impacts.

    • Partner & Platform Engagement

  • Work with external partners such as wallet providers, issuing banks, BaaS platforms, and card networks.

  • Participate in partner discussions to clarify requirements, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to evaluations of vendors, platforms, and capabilities that support the Money Account roadmap.

    • Data, Insights, and Iteration

  • Define and monitor key product metrics related to onboarding, engagement, and usage.

  • Use data, user feedback, and partner insights to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.

  • Continuously refine products based on performance and evolving customer needs.


    • Qualifications & Skills:

    Experience & Background

  • 8–12+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance, or e-commerce.

  • Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional Fintech products from concept to launch.

  • Experience with digital wallets, card issuing, payouts, or BaaS platforms.

  • Strong technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams and APIs.

    • Product & Execution Skills

  • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured product requirements and execution plans.

  • Strong project management and execution skills, including the ability to plan work, manage timelines and dependencies, track action items, and proactively surface risks or blockers.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong proficiency with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, and related tools) to manage backlogs, document requirements, maintain execution visibility, and support prioritization and planning workflows.

  • Data-informed mindset with the ability to use metrics to guide decisions.

    • Collaboration & Mindset

  • Collaborative, humble, and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and reassessing assumptions as new information emerges.

  • A proactive, can‑do mindset with a bias toward action—someone who rolls up their sleeves, tackles problems head-on, and looks for ways to move work forward rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and change, maintaining momentum even as priorities evolve.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with a bias toward ownership and execution.


    • Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with fraud management, risk, chargebacks, or compliance considerations.

  • Experience in gaming, digital goods, and creator platforms.

    • Benefits

This includes unlimited Flexible Time Off, Gym membership, monthly train ticket and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll take ownership of large-scale digital projects from concept through to launch, working across websites, mobile applications, data visualisation products, and other innovative sports technology solutions.

 

You'll act as a trusted partner to both clients and internal teams, ensuring successful delivery while identifying opportunities to maximise value and strengthen client relationships. This is a highly visible role where you'll collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, and Business Development to deliver exceptional outcomes.

Why Join Beyond Sports?

  • Collaborate with talented teams across Product, Design, Engineering, and Delivery.

  • Play a key role in delivering experiences that reach millions of sports fans worldwide.

If you're passionate about delivering exceptional digital products and want to help shape the future of sport through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Inbox)
Product Owner / Manager – DEXIOS SaaS-Plattform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
___________________________________________________________________________

DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!


Deine Aufgaben

PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung

  • Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
  • Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
  • Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
  • Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
  • Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
  • Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
  • Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
  • Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
  • Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
  • Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
  • Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
  • Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
  • Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
  • Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
  • Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
  • Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset 
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
  • Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
  • KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
  • Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
  • Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
  • Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
  • Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
  • Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich


Das bieten wir

  • Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
  • Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
  • KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
  • Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
  • Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub (bei Vollzeit), Homeoffice-Anteil, unbefristete Festanstellung
  • Attraktives Einkommen sowie Benefits wie Team- und Firmenevents, Firmen-Fitnessangebot und Dienstrad-Leasing

jobs.title: Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) - ADAM Audio GmbH
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) – ADAM Audio GmbH

Location: Berlin office / hybrid (Berlin preferred)

Term: Full-time, permanent

Salary: Depending on experience

Start date: as soon as possible

Travel: Up to 20% (trade shows, studio visits, JDM/ODM partners)

  • Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
  • Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
  • Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?

We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.

Role and responsibilities:

  • You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
  • You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
  • Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
  • You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
  • You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.
  • You will act as the internal hub across ADAM Audio, ensuring coordination and information flow across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Support throughout development and commercialisation.
  • You will support go-to-market with pricing strategy, competitive positioning, messaging and go-to-market artefacts (data-sheets, user guides, documentation); track post-launch performance and adjust strategy accordingly.
  • You will monitor in-market response and quality (warranty rates, returns, support tickets, dealer feedback) and prioritise maintenance releases, firmware updates and running changes based on business and user impact.
  • You will represent your products at internal and external events - trade conferences, dealer visits, product launches - and act as a credible point of contact for users.

jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.
 
An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.
  • A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.                  

Think you're a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 
Refer them!

Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.

For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living.

Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.

Unit's description and purpose:

The International Partnerships and Programmes Implementation Unit is responsible for leading and coordinating system-wide resource mobilization and partnership development to enable the delivery and realisation of Fairtrade's strategic priorities. The Unit is also responsible for ensuring effective management of externally funded projects led by Fairtrade International.

Fairtrade International has secured a grant from the European Commission's (EC) Funding Framework Partnership Agreement (FFPA) to deliver a multi-stakeholder four-year project (2024-2027) aiming to:

1.        increase the influence of male and female small producers and workers from local to global level, and create a more inclusive, representative and efficient Fairtrade network

2.       strengthen the institutional and operational capacity of Fairtrade for coordinated actions at the global, regional, and national levels

3.       reinforce the capacity of Fairtrade for coordinated actions at global, regional and national level, that effectively represent producer organisations and workers and promote the role and responsibilities of Fairtrade member organisations

The project is being implemented by Fairtrade International and its three Producer Networks in Latin America and the Caribbean (CLAC), in Africa (FTA) and in Asia and the Pacific (NAPP), as well as the Fair Trade Advocacy Office in Belgium.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • This is a maternity cover position within Fairtrade International.

jobs.title: Lead IT Operations Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As the Lead Tech Business Partner, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for the holding/central employees at 1KOMMA5. This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in the holding will know their Tech Business Partner by name, and have trust to include them in all technical discussions that improve their productivity. You are accountable for the holdings success.

The average day of a Lead Tech Business Partner

The role is divided into 3 key value areas

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2 and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround. Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop. You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability.
  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, setup n8n flows).
  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications. There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.

Your stakeholders will be part of your peer review cycle, in which the score will be based on user satisfaction with your support, project and consulting skills. It will also be used to monitor the user base's enablement, to ensure they know the basics of AI, how and where to create tickets etc.

Typical first 90 days - Specific to Lead Tech Business Partnering

  1. Learn processes and take over support tickets for the business unit assigned to. Report on opportunities to optimize to reduce case load.
  2. Proactively meet with all holding team leads, ideally in-person to introduce and explain the value and purpose of Tech Business Partners.
  3. Take over IT onboarding sessions so that all newbies joining the holding know who their Tech Business Partner is from day one.
  4. Take over leadership responsibilities of IC1-IC3 Tech Business Partners assigned to the holding

Dein Profil

  • Minimum of 10+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field
  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis
  • Proven ability to lead a small and assertive team
  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects
  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications (Zoho CRM is a huge plus) surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security
  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity
  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS, AppScript, Python and Cursor AI
  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus
  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN)
  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management
  • Strong people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions
  • Ability to demonstrate methodology
  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus
  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree - certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus
  • German and English written and verbal communication
  • Willingness to travel primarily to 1KOMMA5 the other holding locations (Munich & Hamburg)

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Meet Urban Sports Club

We are Europe's leading platform for sports and wellness. Our mission is to inspire people to lead active, healthy lives and with just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across Europe.

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating the world's largest wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.

This is an exciting moment to join us: you'll have the chance to be part of a global team and make a real impact on a fast-growing market. Be part of our growth story! Learn more about it here.

The opportunity 

As a Senior Product Designer at Urban Sports Club, you're on a mission to shape the user experience for our valued members and partners.  The way you operate involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams, fostering the creation of digital solutions that go past mere functionality to elevate the holistic user experience. By joining these initiatives, you play a direct and influential role in achieving the overarching business objectives of Urban Sports Club. You own the design process end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional partners in continuous discovery, definition, design, and delivery. You ensure business goals and key objectives inform and guide user-centric innovative solutions. Your designs bring to life products that do not only engage and delight users but also drive the business forward through heightened engagement, satisfaction, and loyalty. 

What you will do

  • You will lead the design and enhancement of intuitive, user-centered web and mobile app experiences
  • You will own and continuously refine design solutions based on user feedback, analytics, and usability testing
  • You will collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to align design decisions with business goals and technical feasibility
  • You will create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs that effectively communicate your ideas
  • You will contribute to building and maintaining our design system component library (basic frontend coding knowledge is a plus)

What you will need to succeed

  • You bring 6+ years of Product Design experience, including at least 2 years in a Senior role, and thrive in a hybrid model attending our Berlin office twice a week
  • You showcase a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, problem-solving, and measurable impact across B2C native mobile and web applications
  • You drive the complete design process in agile environments, collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional teams of PMs, engineers, and designers
  • You conduct user research and usability testing with ease, translating feedback into intuitive and elevated user experiences
  • You leverage usage metrics directly from tools like Google Analytics or Looker to back your design decisions with solid data
  • You utilize AI tools to enable generative UX workflows and accelerate design velocity

What's in it for you 

  • Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
  • Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
  • WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
  • Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
  • Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.

Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

jobs.description:
Dein neues Team:

Du willst KI nicht nur ausprobieren, sondern zuverlässig in Produktion bringen und skalieren? Dann bist Du in unserem AI Team genau richtig.

Du entwickelst KI-basierte Funktionen, Plattformen und Services, die unser Business spürbar voranbringen, und gestaltest unsere KI-Fähigkeiten sowie die technische Basis dafür aktiv mit. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit dem Produktteam und den Fachbereichen zusammen, setzt hohe Standards in Architektur und Umsetzung und unterstützt weniger erfahrene Engineers durch Mentoring und aktiven Wissensaustausch.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • End-to-end Verantwortung: Du verantwortest Themen von der Idee über Design und Architektur bis zur Veröffentlichung und zum Betrieb, erkennst Chancen und Risiken frühzeitig und lieferst messbare Ergebnisse.
  • Skalierbare Systeme: Du entwickelst und betreibst zuverlässige, skalierbare Services und Anwendungen und stellst sicher, dass sie robust, wartbar und gut nachvollziehbar bleiben.
  • Codequalität im Fokus: Du schreibst sauberen, testbaren und effizienten Code, primär in Python, und hebst die Qualität über Reviews, klare Standards und pragmatische Engineering-Praktiken.
  • Nutzerzentrierte Umsetzung: Du arbeitest eng mit Product Managern und Stakeholdern zusammen, entwickelst nutzerzentrierte Funktionen und passt sie schnell an, basierend auf Feedback und Ergebnissen.
  • KI und agentische Systeme: Du identifizierst sinnvolle Einsatzfelder für KI, entwickelst erste Lösungen als Prototypen und bringst AI Agents & Workflows kontrolliert in den produktiven Einsatz, zum Beispiel für Automatisierung, Entscheidungsunterstützung oder die interne Produktivität im Engineering.
  • Architektur und Reviews: Du bringst Dich in technische Design-Entscheidungen und Code Reviews ein und erhöhst die Messlatte für Zuverlässigkeit, Wartbarkeit und Performance.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du verbesserst Systeme, Tools und Prozesse fortlaufend und stärkst damit die Effektivität des Teams nachhaltig.
  • Arbeitsmodell: Du arbeitest remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Düsseldorf oder Berlin, je nach Deiner Präferenz und Teamabstimmung.


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Erfahrung mit KI im Produkt: Du hast KI oder ML Funktionen entwickelt und produktiv ausgerollt, zum Beispiel mit LLM oder Agent Workflows, Prompt und Tooling Patterns, Evals und Monitoring, AI Safety Best Practices oder Datensatz-Design.
  • Senior Software Engineering: Du bringst mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit, verfügst über sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und denkst sicher objektorientiert.
  • Cloud und Auslieferung: Du kennst moderne Entwicklungsabläufe und arbeitest gern in Cloud-Umgebungen, idealerweise mit AWS und cloud-native Deployments.
  • KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Programmierwerkzeuge wie Claude Code, Cursor oder vergleichbare Tools sicher und verantwortungsvoll, um produktiver zu arbeiten.
  • Produktmindset: Du denkst vom Nutzer und vom Ergebnis her und hinterfragst aktiv, warum wir etwas bauen, nicht nur wie.
  • Verantwortung und Durchhaltevermögen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, führst Themen eigenständig von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb und verbesserst sie anschließend iterativ weiter.
  • Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest gern bereichsübergreifend und teilst Wissen aktiv im Team.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und Englisch auf C1 oder C2 Niveau.
  • Plus: Du bist KI-begeistert, hast eigene Projekte und teilst gern Arbeitsproben oder Demos.


Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexibilität für Deine Lebensgestaltung: Genieße familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und eine großzügige Homeoffice-Regelung, damit Du in jeder Lebenslage agil und flexibel bleiben kannst.
  • Ergonomisches Arbeiten: Für Deine Tage im Büro bieten wir ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, die Dir eine komfortable und gesunde Arbeitsumgebung bieten.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Durch kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen wir Dir, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Deine Ideen aktiv einzubringen – bei uns hast Du Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Wachse mit uns: Entfalte Dein Potenzial mit zahlreichen Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem jährlichen Entwicklungsbudget, um Deine fachlichen und persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen.
  • Gemeinsamer Spaß: Der Teamgeist kommt bei uns nicht zu kurz – wir bieten regelmäßig Events und Partys, bei denen der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt.
  • Mobilität nach Wahl: Ob Bahnticket oder Parkplatz – wir unterstützen Dich bei der Wahl Deiner bevorzugten Mobilität.
  • Aktiv bleiben: Halte Dich fit mit einer vergünstigten Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club oder nutze unseren Fitnessraum direkt im Haus, um nach der Arbeit aktiv zu bleiben und Deine Work-Life-Balance zu stärken.
  • Zukunft sichern: Denk auch an Deine Zukunft – wir bieten Dir Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit Du mit uns langfristig planst.
  • Individuelle Angebote: Wir berücksichtigen Deine persönliche Lebenssituation – ob Du ein Elternteil bist oder gerne reist, wir bieten maßgeschneiderte Angebote, die zu Deinem Leben passen.
Deine Perspektive:

Du gestaltest, wie wir KI bei auxmoney produktiv, zuverlässig und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen und überführst neue Anwendungsfälle in skalierbare Systeme. Deine Arbeit sorgt dafür, dass KI-Erlebnisse für Nutzer sowie interne Teams schneller verfügbar werden und sich messbar verbessern. Dabei kannst Du fachlich tiefgehen oder perspektivisch Führung übernehmen, je nachdem, wo Deine Stärken liegen.

Für uns als Arbeitgeber sind Chancengleichheit und Diversität besonders wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns auf Bewerbungen von Müttern, Vätern, Menschen mit Behinderungen und Menschen aus der LGBTQIA+ Community. Bitte teile uns gerne mit, wenn wir z.B. ein geschlechtsneutrales Pronomen verwenden sollen, Du einen barrierefreien Zugang zu unserem Büro benötigst oder wir mehr Zeit für den Bewerbungsprozess einplanen sollen.

(Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 20.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als (Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die ganzheitliche Betreuung deines Kundenportfolios – vom erfolgreichen Onboarding über nachhaltige Produktnutzung bis hin zu Retention, Vertragsverlängerungen und Wachstum. Dabei agierst du als Trusted Advisor für deine Kund:innen und sorgst mit datenbasierten Entscheidungen und kommerziellem Verständnis dafür, dass sie langfristig erfolgreich sind und gemeinsam mit plancraft wachsen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du betreust ein eigenes Kundenportfolio über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle – von Onboarding und Onboarding und Adoption bis hin zu Retention und Expansion.

  • Du führst Onboardingtermine durch und unterstützt Kund:innen dabei, schnell messbaren Mehrwert mit plancraft zu erzielen.

  • Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten, Health Scores und Portfolio-KPIs, um Chancen und Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu priorisieren.

  • Du erstellst strukturierte Customer Success Pläne und führst Business Reviews mit deinen Kund:innen durch.

  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken frühzeitig und leitest gezielte Maßnahmen zur Kundenbindung ein.

  • Du identifizierst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale, qualifizierst diese und schließt Erweiterungen eigenständig ab.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Support, Product, Revenue Operations, Sales und Marketing zusammen, um die bestmögliche Customer Experience zu schaffen.

  • Du bringst strukturiertes Kundenfeedback in Product- und Go-to-Market-Teams ein.

  • Du entwickelst Playbooks, Dokumentationen und skalierbare Customer-Success-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv den Aufbau einer proaktiven und datengetriebenen Customer-Success-Organisation mit.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten B2B-SaaS-Rolle.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung eines Kundenportfolios über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle.

  • Ausgeprägte Beratungsfähigkeit kombiniert mit Sicherheit in kommerziellen Kundengesprächen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen sowie datenbasiertem Portfolio-Management, Dashboards und Health Scores.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und ausgeprägte Priorisierungsfähigkeit.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills.

  • Du verfolgst einen value-driven Verkaufsansatz und verbindest nachweisbaren Kundenmehrwert mit relevanten Expansion-Potenzialen.

  • Freude daran, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzuwirken und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit Consultative Selling, Expansion Playbooks oder kommerziellen Verhandlungen.

  • Erfahrung im SMB- oder Mid-Market-SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse in HubSpot, Intercom, Looker oder Customer-Health-Plattformen.

  • Erfahrung im Handwerk, Bauwesen oder verwandten Branchen.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Customer-Success-Prozesse.

  • Interesse an AI-gestützten Workflows und Automatisierung.

  • Weitere europäische Sprachkenntnisse.

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen Claude-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

Head of Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
Lead the marketing engine behind some of the world's most iconic mobile games.

We’re looking for a Head of Performance Marketing to join Supercell – someone who combines strategic capability and clarity, technical depth, and people-first leadership. You’ll lead our Performance Marketing function, including world-class Performance Marketing teams, ASO, and CRM, driving growth for some of the world’s most iconic mobile games while enabling a talented team to do their best work.

You’ll be deeply embedded in the business by balancing creative ambition with operational excellence, and turning data, technology, and insight into growth.

You will lead a talented team responsible for driving user acquisition and cross-media operations across Supercell’s live and future games. Our Performance Marketing team operates both centrally and embedded within game teams – you’ll need to set direction and enable success across both models, building the systems and culture that empower the team wherever they sit.

This is a role for someone who leads with clarity and empathy, sees the bigger picture without losing sight of impact, and navigates complex organizations with diplomacy and confidence. You’ll partner closely with leaders and teams across Game teams, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Finance, and Creative Production to ensure our media strategies drive long-term growth and business impact.

We pride ourselves on the level of thoughtfulness, quality, and focus put into every aspect of our work. Be it the games themselves or how we communicate them to our players, we are passionate about not compromising on quality ever and choosing a long-term approach to make Supercell a truly global games company that will last for many decades to come.

Let us know if you are who we are looking for!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Shape the strategic vision and direction for Supercell’s Performance Marketing function, ensuring alignment with company and game-level business goals. Drive cross-functional alignment through openness, integrity, and collaboration – ensuring clarity of direction across marketing, analytics, and operations.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Performance Marketing, ASO, and CRM professionals; setting clear goals, fostering autonomy, and creating an environment where people do their best work.

  • Build and maintain measurement frameworks, governance structures, and operational systems that enable the team to perform at their best, alongside coaching and culture that help individuals grow.

  • Build strong partnerships with Game Leads, Marketing Leads, Data, and Finance to ensure marketing investment decisions are data-informed, scalable, and business-driven.

  • Oversee media strategy and governance – ensuring that Supercell’s global marketing efforts are effective, efficient, and future-proofed against evolving market dynamics.

  • Own CRM as a strategic growth lever – ensuring lifecycle and retention strategy is tightly integrated with user acquisition, game-level priorities, and long-term business goals.

  • Embrace AI curiosity and capability – comfortable working with AI-powered campaign tools and platforms, you understand how algorithms make decisions and how to work with them, not just around them. This includes using AI for workflow automation, creative production, and campaign optimization, while staying honest about the trade-offs involved.

  • Push boundaries. Take bold bets. Own risks and back your team when it counts.

What you have

  • Extensive leadership experience in performance marketing and media or operations with a proven track record of leading high-impact, high-scale teams in complex, global organizations.

  • Deep understanding of performance marketing and user acquisition, with the ability to translate complex technical and data-driven concepts into strategic direction. This includes a strong grasp of product dynamics and the interaction between UA and product – understanding how marketing decisions shape and are shaped by the player experience and game economy.

  • Player-first mindset. You believe great marketing ultimately serves the player experience, not just the metrics.

  • Portfolio-level experience managing marketing investment across multiple products at different lifecycle stages, with the ability to allocate, prioritize, and adapt strategy as games grow, mature, or launch.

  • Strong business and financial mindset, able to connect marketing performance to commercial outcomes and broader company goals.

  • Fluent in data and analytics, with the ability to guide strategic decision-making in collaboration with data science and analytics teams.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing senior leaders and aligning diverse perspectives around shared priorities.

  • Diplomatic and emotionally intelligent, with the ability to lead through trust, clarity, and empathy – even in ambiguity.

  • A builder of people and culture, passionate about coaching, growing, and empowering others to succeed.

  • Passion for games and building systems that last.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Where You'll Be

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. The team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios; however, most of our team members and stakeholders are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role, especially if based out of London.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

About SIMBA Voice Agents by Speechify
 
SIMBA lets companies deploy natural, human-sounding AI voice agents in 71+ languages with sub-second latency. We don't just hand customers a product and wish them luck — every customer gets a Forward Deployed Engineer who builds their agents, joins their Slack, and iterates with them weekly. We're building the future of voice AI, and we're looking for someone who can sell that vision and help bring it to life

About the Role

As an Account Executive / Go-to-Market, you're equal parts dealmaker and builder. You'll own the full sales cycle for new customers — from first call to close — while also getting hands-on during technical evaluations, demos, and early deployment. You understand that selling voice AI isn't just about pitching features; it's about showing prospects exactly how SIMBA fits into their world and making that first integration feel effortless.

This is a rare role for someone who can command a boardroom and open a terminal.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close for mid-market and enterprise accounts
  • Run technically deep discovery calls to understand customer use cases, tech stack, and integration requirements
  • Build and demo custom voice agent prototypes during the sales process to accelerate buy-in
  • Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure a seamless handoff from sale to onboarding
  • Develop GTM playbooks, messaging, and outbound strategies to help SIMBA break into new verticals
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and packaging decisions
  • Maintain a clean pipeline in CRM and accurately forecast revenue
What We're Looking For
  • 3–6 years of experience in a sales, account executive, or GTM role at a technical B2B company
  • Track record of closing deals with both technical buyers (CTOs, engineers) and business stakeholders
  • Comfortable getting hands-on with APIs and no-code/low-code tools to build compelling demos
  • Strong understanding of the AI/ML or voice technology landscape — you follow this space closely
  • Exceptional communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts without losing their depth
  • Highly self-directed with strong pipeline discipline and a bias toward action
Nice to Have
  • Experience selling AI, voice, or conversational technology
  • Familiarity with telephony infrastructure, contact centers, or customer experience platforms
  • Prior experience in a forward deployment or solutions engineering capacity
  • Multilingual or experience selling into international markets
Why Speechify SIMBA
  • Sell a product that genuinely impresses prospects — sub-second latency and 71+ languages speaks for itself
  • High ownership role with direct input on GTM strategy and positioning
  • Work alongside a team that stays embedded with customers, so you're never selling something that doesn't deliver
  • Competitive base + commission, equity, and benefits
  • Fast-moving startup environment where your wins have outsized impact

Think you're a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them!

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Senior Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 20,000+ daily active users, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

How We Work

  • AI-First & Data-Driven: We make sure to leverage the latest tech (or build our own) to let our people put their brains to use where they matter most

  • In control. As a self-financed startup, we make decisions, not investors

  • Ownership: We own our work, our wins, and our mistakes. It’s how we grow and improve

  • Excellence: We don't settle for “good enough.” Exceptional is the bar, in everything we do

  • Transparency: What you see is what you get. Open communication, honest processes, and no surprises

  • Candour: Bold, honest conversations that inspire new ideas and solve problems

About the role

We’re looking for a driven, curious, and impact-focused Senior Account Executive to join our growing team. You’ll play a key role in driving revenue growth across mid-market and enterprise accounts by helping organisations automate their ERP processes with AI. At BLP, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close - and directly shape how the next generation of companies operates.

You’ll engage with senior decision-makers (CFOs, CIOs, CPOs, COOs) to uncover challenges, design tailored solutions, and position BLP's platform as a strategic enabler of efficiency and insight. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and customer success to deliver exceptional value throughout the customer journey.

What You'll Own

Pipeline creation & territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

  • Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting; operate a repeatable, metrics-driven cadence.

Insight-led selling & deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction—and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation & close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales & delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close → kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position BLP against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

You’ll get

  • A product that wins. BLP's solution consistently outperforms competitors - your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

Team Lead HR Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
As our Team Lead HR Operations, you are the operational anchor and execution driver of our People engine across German and global entities. You balance empathetic team leadership with ultimate end-to-end accountability for operational delivery, adherence to service SLAs, high data quality standards, and continuous process evolution.

You lead a team of currently three (2 HR Operations Specialists, 1 HR Coordinator), with a focus split across Team Leadership & Governance (40%), Hands-On HR Operational Execution (40%), and Process Optimization & AI Adoption (20%).

This role is designed for someone with the ambition to elevate HR Operations toward a modern, global-first, and zero-backlog setup. You lead by working alongside your team in daily operations (payroll runs, legal contract architecture, onboarding & offboarding best practices) while enforcing robust SOPs, always keeping the internal knowledge base up-to-date, setting clear performance expectations, and navigating constructive change discussions. In close collaboration with your team, cross-functional partners (IT, Finance, Office, Legal, Business), and internal SMEs, you operationalize automated workflows and AI implementations to ensure our process infrastructure scales smoothly as the company grows further.

What you will do:

Team Leadership & Operational Oversight (40%)

jobs.description:
About Quantum-Systems

At Quantum-Systems, we are redefining aerial intelligence. As a global leader in innovative UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) systems, we design and manufacture next-generation VTOL drones that combine cutting-edge AI-driven software and high-performance sensor technology. Our systems are deployed worldwide for defense, security, and commercial applications – enabling real-time aerial ISR capabilities that matter.

Your Mission

As a Solution Architect, you will drive the development of integrated system designs for our unmanned platforms used in demanding defense and security environments.. You will be responsible for designing, evaluating, and developing end-to-end solutions that balance business requirements, technical excellence, security standards, scalability, and cost. You ensure that solutions are robust, scalable, and mission-ready.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead and coordinate the architecture and design of ISR-focused aerial and other unmanned systems based on customer requirements, operational scenarios, and platform capabilities.

  • Define and drive system-level solutions that align with military standards and interoperability requirements (e.g., NATO, BAAINBw).

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with solution management, product management, software, and development teams to ensure technical coherence and mission effectiveness.

  • Interface directly with internal and external stakeholders (including defense customers, government bodies, and integration partners).

  • Produce and maintain system models, architecture views, and documentation using tools such as SPARX EA.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks and support certification and qualification processes.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our systems engineering practices.



What you bring to the team:

  • Strong background in systems design and architecture, ideally with defense and aerospace systems.

  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or System Architect, ideally in a defense-related domain.

  • Familiarity with architecture frameworks and tools (e.g., SPARX EA) and modeling standards.

  • Experience with NATO Architecture Framework (NAFv4) and German defense architecture methodologies such as ADMBw is highly desirable.

  • A university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Business fluency in English and German is required.

  • Willingness and eligibility to obtain security clearance under applicable national laws.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Wir sind Klickkonzept, Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe.
